import subprocess,json
from pathlib import Path
def run(*args):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=20)
 return p.stdout.strip()
print(json.dumps({'production_sha':run('git','-C','/srv/ar-local/AR-local','rev-parse','HEAD'),
 'production_status':run('git','-C','/srv/ar-local/AR-local','status','--porcelain'),
 'bootloader_config':run('vcgencmd','bootloader_config'),'bootloader_version':run('vcgencmd','bootloader_version'),
 'watchdog_manager':run('systemctl','show','-p','RuntimeWatchdogUSec','-p','RebootWatchdogUSec'),
 'watchdog_identity':Path('/sys/class/watchdog/watchdog0/identity').read_text().strip(),
 'watchdog_timeout':Path('/sys/class/watchdog/watchdog0/timeout').read_text().strip(),
 'watchdog_state':Path('/sys/class/watchdog/watchdog0/state').read_text().strip()}))
